reload.label: The reload that forgot its array
reload.explanation: Freeing the dynamic calculations emptied the list but kept the backing pointer array - and adding to an empty list allocates a fresh array, overwriting the retained pointer. A borg reinitialize parses the calculations again, so the previous array is lost on every reload: the original still holds the array after the free (retained=yes) and LeakSanitizer finds the overwritten 80-byte allocation; the correction releases it (retained=no) and that leak is gone. Reloading still works either way: the reparsed formula evaluates to 7 in both.
